govdocs-archive_org-nsia-RECE_RECE: A masthead is the printed nameplate of a periodical, and this one belongs to RECE. RECE was the periodical of the Representación Cubana del Exilio, a Cuban exile organization based in Miami, Florida. Its editor was Jorge Mas Canosa, who became the most powerful voice of the exile community. A masthead fixes a publication's name, its sponsoring body, and its editor. This one preserves those facts for an exile paper of the Cold War years.
